pr_1.title: Claude session state reaches the transcript

nodes.body:
Changes requested before merge.

The change is right and the mechanism checks out: the CLI gates the message on that environment variable, and the SDK's flag-settings layer carries it without replacing the user's own settings.

What is missing is evidence a reviewer can check. Both new tests feed hand-built frames into the mapping, which already handled those shapes; nothing proves the flag reaches the spawned CLI or that the CLI produces the frame. Add a test that starts the backend against a fake executable in place of the real CLI and asserts the variable is present in the child's environment (the Codex backend tests have a fake app-server to copy the shape from). The duplicated state-word cases can fold into the existing "keeps every state word" test.

Also: drop the "Review outcome" section. The pull request format has four sections; a review that found something either got fixed or is a Callout, and one that found nothing adds nothing to the body.
